no_devices_menu.title: No devices found
no_devices_menu.description: This account has no Imou devices yet. Bind a device now, or finish setup. Devices bound later in the Imou app are not polled until you select them under Configure → Manage devices.

select_devices.title: Select Devices
select_devices.description: Found {device_count} device(s) on your account. Select the devices you want to add to Home Assistant. Unselected devices will NOT be polled, saving API quota. You can bind more devices later under Settings → Devices & services → Imou Life → Configure → Manage Devices.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Imou Life
reauth_confirm.description: Your App Secret is no longer valid. Enter a new App Secret for AppId {app_id}.

event_push_no_external_url.title: Imou event push has no callback URL
event_push_no_external_url.description: Event push is enabled but Home Assistant could not build an external webhook URL. Set **Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL**, or enter a manual callback URL in Imou Life options.

event_push_callback_failed.title: Imou event push registration failed
event_push_callback_failed.description: Home Assistant could not register the message callback with Imou Open Platform. Check the callback URL and your AppId resource quota, then reload the integration.

error.bind_device_not_listed: Device was bound but does not appear in the account device list yet. Try again in a moment.

init.title: Configure Imou Life
init.description: Choose which settings to change. Each section saves when you submit that form.

data_description.enable_polling: When disabled, the integration does not periodically refresh device status from Imou cloud. Use this if you only need on-demand controls (e.g. siren, collection point). Entity states may become outdated. Setup and reload still fetch the device list once.
data_description.update_interval: How often to poll device status from Imou cloud. Default 300s (5 minutes), range 30–900s. Ignored when status polling is disabled.
data_description.download_snap_wait_time: Seconds to wait before downloading a camera snapshot. Default 3s.
data_description.live_resolution: Camera live stream resolution. HD = high definition, SD = standard.
data_description.live_protocol: Video stream protocol. Usually https is fine.
data_description.rotation_duration: How long a single PTZ button press moves. Default 500ms.

event_push.title: Event push

data_description.enable_event_push: Registers the callback URL with Imou cloud. Alarm events also sync to the Imou app.

callback.name: Callback URL
callback.description: Leave **Custom callback URL** empty to use the suggested URL above. Enter a public URL only if the suggested address is not reachable from the internet.

subscriptions.name: Message types
subscriptions.description: Choose which Imou cloud messages to receive after event push is enabled.

notifications.name: Alarm notifications
notifications.description: Optional automatic notifications when an alarm arrives.

data_description.notify_services: Comma-separated HA actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty to use automations only.

devices.title: Manage devices
devices.description: Found {device_count} device(s). Select which devices to poll. Unselected devices stay in Home Assistant but are not polled, saving API quota. Submit saves and closes.

bind_new_device.name: Bind a new device
bind_new_device.description: Optional. Bind another camera to this account, then it is added to the poll list.

data_description.device_id: Serial number (SN) printed on the device or shown in the Imou app. Leave empty to skip binding.
data_description.code: Optional. Leave empty if the device does not require a binding code

no_devices_menu.title: No devices found
no_devices_menu.description: This account has no Imou devices yet. Bind a device now, or save without binding.

devices_unavailable.title: Could not reach the Imou cloud
devices_unavailable.description:
The device list could not be fetched: {error}

You can try again, or save your other changes and leave the device selection as it is.

bind_device.title: Bind device
bind_device.description: Enter the device serial number and binding code from the Imou app or device label.

data_description.code: Optional. Leave empty if the device does not require a binding code

options.alarm: Device alarms (smoke, gas, human, motion, etc.)

stream_source_failed.message: Could not get the live stream URL from Imou: {error}

camera_image_failed.message: Could not get a snapshot from Imou: {error}

not_a_ptz_button.message: {entity_id} is not a PTZ button, so it cannot be moved. Target a PTZ direction button instead.

remove_device_missing_id.message: Cannot remove device {name}: missing Imou device id.

remove_device_has_siblings.message: Cannot remove {name}: it is one channel of Imou device {device_id}, which also covers {siblings}. Deselect the whole device in the integration options to stop polling it, or disable this channel's entities to hide it.

remove_device_no_runtime.message: Cannot remove device {name}: integration is not loaded.
